uncited: Unlike [Dense grids and memory layout](3-dense-grids-and-memory-layout.md) which assumes full residency, or [Compression](4-compression.md) which focuses on storage density, this family focuses on the dynamic management of data movement and computational load to maintain real-time framerates [Parent].
**Decomposition Strategy**: The volume or dataset is partitioned into subdomains, bricks, or cells.
**Work Assignment**: Each processor (or memory tier) is assigned a subset of the partitioned data.
**Compositing Order**: For correct alpha compositing, the relative depth order of rendered partitions must be preserved.
**Communication Overhead**: Methods must account for the cost of transferring data to processors and transferring partial images for compositing.
